Making the flanges and ribs deeper (17 and 19 mm) dropped it to 0.905, so I went back to 15 and 16 mm.

The part was built from a script, so `part.FCStd` has no editable feature tree. That's fine for the STEP file but would fail a check that requires native PartDesign features.
